comment: Approved differences between the legacy transcripts and the settlement service. A scenario listed here is judged against its 'expected' block instead of the transcript and is reported as CHANGED (<change>) by make parity; anything else is still a FAIL. Each entry must name a docs/changes/CHG-nnn record (ADR-001, 'Behaviour freeze').
transcript_rules_comment: Which SPEC-SETTLE-001 rules each settlement transcript is evidence for, taken from the 'Observed:' lines of the spec. tools/traceability.py reads this to put transcripts and their parity verdicts next to each rule. An entry without a version (SETTLE-R05) applies to every version of that rule; a version-qualified entry (SETTLE-R06 (v2)) applies to that version only.
payment_rules_comment: Payment entries of transcript_rules: which SPEC-PAY-001 rules each payment scenario is evidence for, taken from the 'Observed:' lines of the spec. payment_issue and payment_history are transcripts; payment_live_Lnn is live request Lnn of docs/specs/SPEC-PAY-001-live.json and payment_live_db_after its db_after queries. L02 and L35 (sign in) and L05 (settlement save) are setup, not scenarios (ADR-002).

approved_differences.summary: A non-blank, unparseable deductible is a validation error instead of the error screen
